ws_piece_waystone_description: Helps you find a way to a distant places
ws_piece_waystone_activation: You touch the cold stone surface and you think of home
ws_tutorial_waystone_text:
Waystones allow you to <color=yellow>fast travel</color> to distant locations and other waystones.

Sit in front of a waystone and begin your search.
Locate a distant place with your gaze to fast travel there.

<color=yellow>Activate and mark</color> a waystone to be able to return to it later.
ws_tutorial_waystone_text_orientation:
Waystones help you <color=yellow>search and orient</color> by distant locations and active waystones.

Sit in front of a waystone and begin your search.
Aim at markers to check direction and distance.

<color=yellow>Activate and mark</color> a waystone to see it from distance.
